text: Cooking involves heating ingredients using various methods. The initial phase consists of simmering: a liquid is kept at low heat until a target temperature is reached, allowing embedded components to cook. This technique promotes uniform cooking and the blending of tastes. Next, seasoning occurs when extra items are introduced to improve flavor; selecting optimal seasonings depends on the dish and intended profile. The process concludes by maintaining the simmer for sufficient duration, typically until the product achieves tenderness and full doneness.
